subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and if yes should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver`, `cli.tui.deliver`, or a non-config TUI preference?
rationale: The missing capability is clear, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and current docs intentionally make delivery an explicit launch-time choice.

options.title: Approve canonical config default
options.body: Add one documented boolean default with schema/types/docs and tests for config fallback plus explicit `--deliver` and `--no-deliver` overrides.

options.title: Keep delivery launch-only
options.body: Leave delivery as an explicit per-session flag and document that this is an intentional product decision.

options.title: Use a TUI preference flow
options.body: Defer a global config key and design a TUI-owned persisted setting or setup affordance instead.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical config default
recommendation.body: Add one documented boolean default with schema/types/docs and tests for config fallback plus explicit `--deliver` and `--no-deliver` overrides.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing signal is broad TUI/config ownership plus current-line provenance across the affected entrypoint/runtime files.
